# thelake

> Open source AI evidence lake on DuckDB — the LangSmith / Datadog alternative built for long-term storage of large full payloads at ~200x lower cost than index-heavy observability platforms.

thelake is an Apache-2.0 Rust runtime: OTLP traces and logs in; DuckLake + Parquet on object store or disk; DuckDB SQL and Grafana-compatible Loki/Tempo query APIs out. Softprobe Agent QA is built on thelake.

## Site

- [Landing](https://thelake.softprobe.ai/): Product positioning, architecture overview, quick start
- [API docs (Swagger)](https://thelake.softprobe.ai/swagger): HTTP API reference
- [GitHub](https://github.com/softprobe/thelake): Source, README, License.txt
- [Softprobe](https://www.softprobe.ai/): Commercial Agent QA product powered by thelake
